name: I'm a Celebrity: Get Me Out of Here!
description: Australian celebrities are dropped into the African jungle with little more than their wits, strength and willpower to survive the competition. How will they cope with African wildlife, a constant series of challenges and tests, basic rations and their fellow campmates? Who will survive the infamous Bush Tucker Trials? Who will win the hearts of viewers and be crowned King or Queen of the Jungle?

videos.title: I’m a Celebrity... Saturday Schoolies
videos.overview: Our celeb’s are ripped from camp to the classroom to report to their teacher, Mr. Scott Tweedie. Who will give them random & ridiculous challenges for their chance to win The Golden Lunchbox.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Tonight's premiere episode sees ten celebrities dropped deep into the South African jungle with little more than their wits, strength and willpower to survive.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: It's day two in the jungle and some of the celebrities have had more trouble than others getting use to giving up their five-star lifestyles. Hosted by Dr Chris Brown and Julia Morris.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: It's day three in the jungle and some of the celebrities have had more trouble than others getting use to giving up their five-star lifestyles. Hosted by Dr Chris Brown and Julia Morris.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: It's day four in the jungle and some of the celebrities have had more trouble than others getting use to giving up their five-star lifestyles. Hosted by Dr Chris Brown and Julia Morris.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: It's day five in the jungle and some of the celebrities have had more trouble than others getting use to giving up their five-star lifestyles. Hosted by Dr Chris Brown and Julia Morris.

videos.title: Episode 6 (Live Eviction)
videos.overview: The celebrities have survived their first week in the jungle. The camp site isn't quite a holiday oasis with cocktails whipped up at the snap of a finger. Who is thriving and who is barely surviving?

videos.title: Episode 7 (Intruders Special)
videos.overview: Without the comforts of home, the celebrities real personalities are starting to emerge. There are sure to be plenty of surprises as some become besties and others are driven apart.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: With the abundance of animals roaming Africa, most species depend on safety in numbers rather than hiding from predators. The animals are smart enough to form alliances but are the celebrities?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Kruger National Park is most famous for its large carnivores: lions, leopards, cheetahs, hyenas and wild dogs. Here's hoping the celebrities are a bit tougher than their headshots make them out to be.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The celebrities have almost survived their second week and should start thinking about how to strategise. It may be a good idea to look to their jungle neighbours for advice.

videos.title: Episode 11 (Live Double Eviction)
videos.overview: Having been tested both physically and mentally, the celebrities have fought hard to secure fresh food and special privileges, but in this episode, another celebrity will leave the jungle.

videos.title: Episode 12 (Intruders Special)
videos.overview: The celebrities have little time to adjust to losing yet another one of their camp mates as they embark on this episode's Tucker Trial and Chest Challenge.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: With their daily rations becoming increasingly bland, the celebrities are desperate to win extra food and treats for the camp. This episode, they are faced with a Twisted Takeaway Tucker Trial.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: This episode's Tucker Trial, Jungle Jive, will give one of the celebrities the opportunity to hit the dance floor. But little do they know, there is a massive twist.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: It is Triple Threat Thursday and the High Rollers Tucker Trial will see two celebrities pushed to their limit. Later, the celebrities will have to prove themselves in a Chest Challenge.

videos.title: Episode 16 (Live Eviction)
videos.overview: Tonight we farewell another celebrity. Later, two celebrities will be forced to hunt for ten letters using their bare hands, in elephant dung in the Chest Challenge - Goddung Mess.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: The celebrities haven't received any pampering or comforts since entering the jungle but tonight one lucky celebrity will be given the opportunity to experience various treatments in the Safari Spa.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: As the celebrities continue to complain of hunger and their thoughts continually drift to their favourite food, two celebrities will enjoy some traditional South African food in tonight's Tucker Trial.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: In tonight's Tucker Trial Safari Spa, Freddie Flintoff will be pampered in his very own jungle spa with a difference, joined by some very frisky critters. Will Freddie face a facial full of maggots.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: This episode, the Tucker Trial sees two celebrities harnessed to a bungee and secured to the ground in the Celebrity Slingshot. The area the celebrity hits will determine how many meals they earn for camp.

videos.title: Episode 21 (Live Eviction)
videos.overview: In a Fluffy Animals Chest Challenge, two celebrities must find the code for the chest hidden in four animal pens. Later, it is time for another eviction as one camp mate is sent packing their bags.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: One celebrity's levels of balance and tenacity gets tested at great height in the Torn Free Tucker Trial. One wrong step and they could take a terrifying plunge into the canyon.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: In a stomach-turning Tucker Chewsday Trial, the celebrities must consume various body parts from a number of animals to earn the vital stars.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: In a body of water, two celebrities must work an egg through the body of an artificial snake to reveal the combinations in the Snake's Egg Chest Challenge.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: It is raining hippos in a Hoard Of Hippos Chest Challenge as two celebrities must go up against Africa's deadliest animals as they come flying over the waterfall.

videos.title: Episode 26 (Live Eviction)
videos.overview: After six gruelling weeks, the hunger, tears and trials reach an explosive conclusion, with live evictions as we count down to crowning the King or Queen of the Jungle.

videos.title: Episode 27 (Live Eviction)
videos.overview: Chained inside a large tank by their feet, hands and waist, one celebrity must escape their watery bounds in the flash flood Tucker Trial.

videos.title: Episode 28 (Live Eviction)
videos.overview: Can one celebrity overcome their unyielding hunger and choose their fellow camp mates' needs over their own comfort in the disgustation Tucker Trial?

videos.title: Episode 29 (Live Double Eviction)
videos.overview: In this episode's Chest Challenge, one celebrity is trapped hanging in a net weighted by a large barrel of water. Their partner must carefully release the water in order to lower and save the captured celeb.

videos.title: Episode 30 (Live Eviction)
videos.overview: After the final eviction, all remaining celebrities must work together to complete a Tucker Trial while being battered by a barrage of wind machines, tidal waves of water, mud and slime.

videos.title: Finale
videos.overview: After six weeks in the remote South African jungle, 14 celebrities have been whittled down to three. This climatic finale will see the first King or Queen of the Jungle crowned live!

videos.title: Opening Night/Welcome to the Jungle
videos.overview: On the anticipated season premiere, the identity of the 10 new celebrities going into the African jungle will finally be revealed! How will they cope when faced with their first group challenge?

videos.title: Up To Your Neck In It
videos.overview: On day two, find out how the celebrities are handling their new no-frills lifestyle in the African jungle! Plus, they can expect a nasty surprise when they discover What's in the Box?

videos.title: Spin The Bottle
videos.overview: Which celebrities will be voted to face the first food challenge of the season? Last year we saw impala's kidney, pigtail, maggots and cockroaches; what new African delights are on the menu tonight?

videos.title: Cliff Hanger
videos.overview: Day four in the jungle will see the celebrities take part in a game of Trick or Treat! From creepy crawlies to dangerous animals? what will the celebrities come head-to-head with tonight?

videos.title: The Viper Room
videos.overview: Julia and Chris return live to camp to inform who will compete in the week's final challenge! Will the celebrities be able to take on the next adventurous trial and bring home the tucker?

videos.title: Croc Bait (Live Eviction)
videos.overview: The celebrities have made it through their first full week in the jungle. Let's celebrate by throwing the most terrifying trial in the history of the show.

videos.title: Feeding Time
videos.overview: Giant ostriches have been known to disembowel lions when cornered. So what could possibly go wrong when our celebs collect stars hidden within ostrich eggs, buried in a pen full of the giant birds?

videos.title: Beat The Birds
videos.overview: Our poor celebrities will have to eat what the local wildlife has chosen for them to eat. Will the monkey choose to eat the bowl of jelly, or the bowl of crickets? Bon appetit.

videos.title: Worlds End
videos.overview: To win meals for the camp, one celebrity will answer questions from inside phone boxes. Can they keep their cool while combating critter dumps, flooding tanks and fly chambers?

videos.title: Feral Foot Fetish
videos.overview: It's the delightfully named 'feral foot fetish'. Using only their feet, a celebrity must correctly identify local animals to earn stars, while waist deep in a tank full of critters.

videos.title: Creepy Callies (Live Eviction)
videos.overview: Valentine's Day. The day when millions put their hearts on the line, but tonight one celebrity will put their life on the line, in a terrifying 100ft challenge.

videos.title: Shaken And Stirred
videos.overview: Get ready for a cocktail like no other. With bugs, giant ice cubes, and celebrities being tossed around in a giant shaker as they try to collect stars.

videos.title: Pub Crawl
videos.overview: Our hungry celebrities will be invited on a pub crawl into the welcoming surrounds of an African tavern. Unfortunately for them, it won't serve your typical pub fare.

videos.title: Tug of War
videos.overview: In a twist on the blind date, one blindfolded celebrity will enter a pitch black cave while another verbally guides them in search of meal stars through critter dumps and local fauna.

videos.title: In Your Face
videos.overview: After three gruelling weeks, the hunger, tears and trials reach an explosive conclusion with live evictions every night this week as we count down to crowning the King or Queen of the Jungle.

videos.title: Mine Shaft Mystery (Live Eviction)
videos.overview: As the celebrities begin week four of their jungle journey, one will be chosen to head down the rabbit hole. Well, more like an African critter hole to be exact.

videos.title: Sticky Wiki
videos.overview: The celebrities go head-to-head in a game of tug of war for their dinner. They'll be suspended over a dam wall, two at a time. Who will plump and who will plummet?

videos.title: Fast Food
videos.overview: It's a sushi train, jungle style. Five celebs take a seat at the jungle grub train, and when the conveyor belt of African delicacies passes before them, they must consume their dish before it is gone.

videos.title: Blind Date
videos.overview: In the sticky wiki trial, one celeb takes a test of endurance, as they enter a chamber and endure critter and slime drops while reciting passages from their Wikipedia page to earn meals for camp.

videos.title: Memorable Trip
videos.overview: This challenge sees two celebrities in for a memorable trip as they are placed within the confines of a car and challenged to remember a series of items that move past them on a conveyor belt.

videos.title: Hole Lotta Trouble
videos.overview: One celeb is in for a 'hole' lot of trouble. Not only do they have to put their hands into holes filled with creepy crawlies, but they have to do it while hanging off a large rock face.

videos.title: Screaming Headache
videos.overview: This tucker trial will be a massive headache for one celeb. They must stand on their head inside a perspex box as it fills with water, live eels and and other slimy aquatic creatures.

videos.title: Ropable
videos.overview: The celebs put a new spin on the phrase 'walking a fine line'. In the trial aptly titled ropeable, two celebrities are faced with the daunting task of crossing a dam wall to collect flags.

videos.title: Wreck-fast
videos.overview: Two celebs will get up close and personal with African critters in a way they would never have dreamt of. To win meals for camp, they must hold different creatures in their mouth.

videos.title: Jungle Houdini
videos.overview: A celeb must escape a cage that is slowly sinking into a lake. The keys they need are in the cage with them, but they must think quickly and methodically as only half the keys will work on the locks.

videos.title: Dam Shame
videos.overview: One lucky celebrity will need to crawl and navigate their way through pipes within the dam wall in search of meal stars, joined by an array of water-friendly natives.

videos.title: Wheel of Misfortune
videos.overview: In what is likely to be a bad trip down memory lane, one or more celebrities will revisit a horrendous trial from the season.

videos.title: Hipster Horror
videos.overview: The latest tucker chewsday challenge is top secret. What local delights will be on the menu? What will the celebrities be able to stomach in order to feed the camp?

videos.title: Mind The Gap
videos.overview: Each celebrity must take a running jump off the dam wall in an attempt to grab hold of a cargo net. The camp will earn a meal for every successful jump.

videos.title: Flash Flood 2.0: Flash Harder
videos.overview: One celebrity will be placed inside a large clear tank and chained up by their feet, hands and waist. As the tank fillls with water, they must find the keys to freedom or face a watery coffin.

videos.title: Finale
videos.overview: After 6 grueling weeks just 3 celebrities remain, and only 1 will be crowned King or Queen of the Jungle, LIVE! But, there's still one last Tucker Trial they have to complete... and boy, it's a doozy!

videos.overview: Here's hoping our six chosen celebrities aren't afraid of heights - and water. Actually, let's hope they are. Later on, who will say goodbye to the campsite forever?

videos.overview: Will the celebrities be able to keep their cool while combating critters crawling around their hands, feet and mouths? Later, camp mates will be treated to a delightful or not-so-delightful surprise.

videos.overview: It's Horror Day for our celebrities. If the celebrities thought the film Snakes On A Plane was confronting, they had better brace themselves for Snakes in a Chamber.

videos.title: A Trip Down Memory Pain
videos.overview: I'm A Celebrity...Get Me Out Of Here! is embracing their own Throwback Thursday with a challenge titled A Trip Down Memory Pain.

videos.title: Jungle's Got Zero Talent

videos.title: Throwing Up
videos.overview: The celebrities will have to overcome their fear of heights in order to win a meal for the camp. Will the high wire get the better of them?

videos.title: Blind Date
videos.overview: It's Valentine's Day and if the celebrities thought flowers and PDA's were hard to stomach then they better brace themselves for this tucker trial.

videos.title: Grim Gallery
videos.overview: In this episode, two celebrities must collect stars through a flooded tunnel filled with aquatic creatures. Will the celebrities return to camp victorious or defeated? More Info

videos.overview: Which celebrity will hang from the end of a crane over a floating tank of snakes while blindfolded and collect stars to win a meal for the camp?

videos.title: Wheel Will Rock You
videos.overview: All of the remaining celebrities are required to compete in the Turntable of Terror trial. In this jungle casino, there is only one thing you can bet on. No-one is safe!

videos.title: A Floody Hard Tucker Trial
videos.overview: Life imitates art when one unlucky celebrity checks in to the Grim Gallery. Will it be a picture-perfect ending, or will the celebrity get tongue tied? Later, who or what is in the box?

videos.title: A Day At The Races
videos.overview: Two unlucky celebrities take a seat at the jungle saloon for a variety of special African delicacies. Maggot Milkshake anyone?

videos.overview: In a game of pure nerve and stability, one celebrity must scale a huge tower which is leaning over the world's end. Can the celebrity collect enough stars to bring food home to camp?

videos.title: Dicing With Danger
videos.overview: Two unlucky celebrities will compete in a trial called Dicing With Danger. In this trial, a roll of the dice will not prove nice. Plus, who or what is in the box?

videos.overview: The jungle family are heading to the movies as the celebrities compete in bush tucker trials set amongst classic movie scenes and props. Plus, who is the next celebrity to leave the jungle?

videos.overview: On a strict time limit, two celebrities must search for keys in a critter filled jungle kitchen to unlock bins full of offal and transfer as much as they can onto scales to win meals for camp.

videos.title: You Choose
videos.overview: Tucker Chewsday returns to wreak havoc on the jungle squad in a gruesome wheel of fortune challenge to create a classic dish using some of South Africa's most terrifying toppings.

videos.title: Riding High
videos.overview: Two celebrities will ride a motorbike along narrow tracks suspended over the ravine in order to win meals for camp. Will it be all eyes on the prize? Or will the celebrities go off track?

videos.title: Shooting Stars
videos.overview: Three celebrities will need to throw golden nuggets into a bucket while being attached to a reverse bungee rig. Will the trio shoot and score?

videos.title: Gross Train
videos.overview: In a program first, things will go bump in the night when the celebrities compete in their first night trial.

videos.title: As Scream On TV
videos.overview: Two celebrities will trade being on the TV for being in the TV. Later, the celebrities will be treated to a surprise delivery in camp. What or who could be in the box?

videos.title: CarnEVIL
videos.overview: In a nasty spin on the drinking game beer pong, which two unlucky celebrities will be forced to play Good Cup Bad Cup?

videos.title: Floods Of Fear
videos.overview: One celebrity will make their way through a flooded tunnel system, collecting stars among a variety of terrifying aquatic creatures. Will they return to camp victorious, or arrive empty-handed?

videos.title: Help From Our Friends
videos.overview: The camp superstars will be faced with a list of general knowledge questions. They must choose an evicted celebrity to answer each category.

videos.title: Family Tree
videos.overview: The final four's loved ones will embark on South African soil. Later on, four will become three as another celebrity leaves the jungle.

videos.title: Grand Finale
videos.overview: Don't miss the grand finale when one of the final three will be crowned King or Queen of The Jungle and win $100,000 for their chosen charity.

videos.title: The Jungle Prep Centre
videos.overview: In the highly anticipated fourth season, the identity of the celebrities braving the South African jungle will finally be revealed.

videos.title: A Bridge Too Far
videos.overview: It's day two in the jungle and the celebrities have just spent their first night with the animals, no shelter and no contact with the outside world.

videos.overview: One celebrity must face their fears in the dark enclosure filled with unwanted visitors and creepy-crawlies. Will they survive the challenge?

videos.overview: One celebrity must face their fears in the dark enclosure filled with unwanted visitors and creepy-crawlies. Will they survive the challenge?

videos.overview: In the first elimination of the season, the celebrity with the least number of votes will be sent packing. With one less celebrity, how will the rest of the camp react?

videos.title: Feeling Flushed
videos.overview: In an attempt to win stars to feed the hungry camp, the celebrities must capture stars that will come flowing downs chute along with floods of water and all creepy jungle critters.

videos.overview: What happens when you remove celebrities’ vision and throw them into an eating trial in the pitch black? All their senses become enhanced and the dishes taste worse than ever.

videos.title: The World's End
videos.overview: It is without doubt one of the toughest days in camp Valentine’s Day. What surprises will Chris and Julia have up their sleeve to celebrate this very romantic day?

videos.overview: Two celebrities leave the camp in search of the celebrity chest. Will the camp be successful in winning the contents of the chest and gain a much needed treat

videos.overview: It’s another huge week as the celebrities struggle to cope with meagre food rations, basic accommodation and the harsh conditions. Later which celebrity will bid farewell to their camp mates?

videos.title: Holy Water
videos.overview: Which celebrity will receive the most public votes and face a trail to win stars to feed their hungry camp mates? Will they succeed or will they come back empty handed?

videos.title: I Scream Shop
videos.overview: The most dreaded day of the week, Tucker Chewsday, returns to wreak havoc, and the jungle menu is packed with some of South Africa’s most disgusting delights.

videos.overview: The five celebrities chosen to compete in the trial will be split into two teams - targets and shooters. Will the celebrities hit all the targets in time to win five stars for the camp?

videos.overview: The pressure is on as the celebrities need to earn as many stars as possible to feed the camp over the weekend or face a three-day diet of rice and beans.

videos.title: The School of Hard Shocks
videos.overview: World famous psychic John Edwards swings into the jungle to take a read on the campmates. Will all the stars align or will the sceptics remain in doubt?

videos.title: Big Babies
videos.overview: It's the trial that will have the Royal Butler Paul Burrell and AFL Superstar Josh Gibson screaming like Big Babies. Who will be the first to spit the dummy?

videos.title: African Mornings
videos.overview: In today's Tucker Trial, three celebrities will be stepping out of camp and onto the set of the fictitious jungle television program, African Mornings with Chris and Julia.

videos.title: The Launch
videos.overview: Julia Morris and Chris Brown host this reality series that sees celebrities live together in a South African jungle camp, coping with a few creature comforts. Each contestant participates in challenges to secure additional food and treats for the group, but also to avoid being voted out by viewers during their stay, with the final episode's votes nominating who wins a series and become crowned as "Jungle King/Queen". Celebrities participating on the programme receive a donation to a charity they nominate, with the money raised from charges on voting via text, phone or interactive services

videos.title: Flying Blind
videos.overview: Through the tears, fears and gory foods, who will survive the jungle? Not only do these celebs have to survive challenges, they’ll have to survive each other.

videos.title: Frost Fight
videos.overview: Who will survive the frost fight challenge? Tonight, potential love birds, Angie and Justin face off in an attempt to win for their campmates.

videos.title: Breakfast in Bed
videos.overview: Tonight, Jacqui, Justin, Natasha and Justine are treated to breakfast in bed - will they be able to stomach it? YUCK.

videos.title: Basket Fall
videos.overview: Tonight, Justin is up for a third challenge - this time, against Luke. Who will slam dunk and dribble their way to victory on a beam that's 20 stories high? And who will free-fall?

videos.title: The Sunday Slam
videos.overview: Tahir and Justin go head to head. Plus, don't miss the latest celeb to enter the jungle - a former AFL Footy Show host. Celebrities live together in a South African jungle camp, coping with a few creature comforts.

videos.overview: Shane Crawford enters the African jungle as Camp Captain with Justin Lacko taking him through his first challenge in the Tunnel of Terror. it's going to scare the pants off them.

videos.title: Drop and Pop!
videos.overview: Two lucky celeb's are going to be dropped and popped in today's challenge - it's going to go off with a bang.

videos.title: One Shock Shop
videos.overview: Do not miss a cracker of an episode as Justin, Richard, Luke and Natasha head to the local jungle supermarket to do a spot of shopping for the camp.

videos.title: Sunday Slam #2
videos.overview: A bold, Hollywood, A-List star is making their grand entrance into the African jungle - who could it be?

videos.title: The Bathtub of Terror
videos.overview: Katherine Kelly Lang enters the jungle to mix things up.

videos.title: Escape From The Viper Room
videos.overview: Yvie Jones and Luke Jacobz have won a VIP pass to the Viper room - but this year, there is a twist. There's no slithering out of this one.

videos.title: Groundhog Day
videos.overview: There are a few things that Katherine Kelly Lang needs to adjust to - and that includes Justin Lacko. Will she ever be able to get a word in?

videos.title: Sunday Slam #3
videos.overview: Get ready for the Sunday Slam. Katherine is about to get slammed and she's also in for a shocking twist. Plus, there is an elimination. Who will be leaving?

videos.title: Last Gasp!

videos.overview: Celebrities will arrive at a garbage disposal centre filled with rubbish. To earn stars, the celebrities must find items using clues, and one celebrity will be going home.

videos.title: The Scariest Trial We've Ever Done!
videos.overview: The trials department are high-fiving themselves over this one. They are calling it the scariest trial we’ve ever done, and this episode, one of the group will be leaving the jungle.

videos.title: Viper Room
videos.overview: One celebrity is trapped in The Viper Room, the underground, pitch black coffin that slowly fills with creepy crawlies. Their only chance of escape is via their fellow celebrities back in camp.

videos.overview: In this episode’s trial, our celebrities’ knowledge of animal calls and the camps ability to mimic those sounds will be put to the test. Get the answer wrong and they get a dunk full of offal.

videos.title: Oh My Gob. - Elimination
videos.overview: Trial goers take turns kicking balls at cardboard cut-outs of celebs with open mouths. Each ball has the name of a dish inscribed on it. Whichever mouth the ball enters determines who eats the dish.

videos.title: Electric Circus - Elimination
videos.overview: Campmates will try their luck at carnival favourites that have had torturous makeovers. To win stars, each celebrity must beat the games to earn meals for the camp - while rigged to electrodes. Zap!

videos.title: Buns of Steel - Elimination
videos.overview: Finals week kicks off with Super Hero Sunday. To earn stars, celebs must bungee jump 60m holding pickles they need to place onto a jumbo build-a-burger. Plus, there is another jungle elimination.

videos.overview: Two celebrities must effectively communicate to each other to retrieve stars in their respective tunnels. If they fail, they'll fall into the water below. Oh, and there are crocodiles in the water. Snap!
